cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — pours the batter from a mixing bowl of batter and a whisk into a baking tin; her bedroom — lying on her left side; the grand staircase of an old castle — standing; A small clockmaker's balcony with an open worktable overlooking slate roofs and a stone bell tower — She tests whether a tiny brass pendulum will keep time; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; A quiet upper room of a medieval inn — She slips out of her traveling shrug and hangs it over the chair before checking the knot on tomorrow's satchel; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — kneeling on the ground; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — kneeling on one knee; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a small live house with a low stage — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — carries a small red paper lantern by its cord
